correctness.rationale: On the open interval the derivative measure consists of the cell slopes and atoms of sizes d_j−λ(s_j+s_{j+1})/2. For a single input, both slopes bordering d_j have its sign or vanish and are no larger in magnitude; 0≤λ≤1 preserves the sign of the jump. Summing the absolute jumps subtracts precisely the interior slope variation because both end slopes are zero. For a pair of inputs, along a segment minmod locally selects either zero or one adjacent increment, yielding nonnegative secant weights α,β with α+β≤1, also valid across ties by continuity and compactness of the coefficient simplex. Fix the secant coefficients and express the input difference in step columns plus a constant. A unit step can drive only the two adjacent cell slopes a,b in [0,1], with endpoint slopes zero. Its interior contribution is λ(a+b), its two exterior jumps sum in magnitude to λ(a+b)/2, and its central jump is nonnegative and equals 1−λ(a+b)/2. The column gain is 1+λ(a+b). Triangle inequality bounds it by 1, 1+λ or 1+2λ depending on available interior cells. For n=3 the witness increments (1,2) become (3/2,2), driving the only slope; for n≥4 the increments (2,1,2,3,…) become (2,3/2,2,3,…), driving two slopes by the same perturbation. The two-site constant and λ=0 follow directly from the piecewise constant difference.
residual_risks: The result counts interface jumps in distributional BV and fixes zero endpoint slopes, not zero endpoint values. No assertion about other conventions or a full time-step is certified.
Reported tests were not independently rerun; the mathematical argument proves the stated all-parameter result.

value.rationale: The sharp norm determines how data perturbations can be amplified in distributional variation even when each reconstruction preserves variation exactly. The dimension cutoffs quantify the number of slopes responding to one edge, and the scaling law lets an analyst choose λ for a specified perturbation amplification limit. Exact jump accounting and positive-size witnesses are needed; individual TVD alone does not give this information.
residual_risks: This value is for the reconstruction operator alone; the bound does not determine stability of a flux/time-evolution scheme.
